_comment: Hand-maintained ABI tables that webgpu.json does not encode. Consumed by codegen/gen.py.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_abi_version
special_imports.c: uint32_t %s(void)
special_imports.doc: Host ABI revision. The shim refuses to run against a host that reports a different major revision.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_object_instance
special_imports.c: uint32_t %s(uint32_t handle)
special_imports.doc: Instance handle an object descends from, or 0. Events are delivered per instance.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_instance_request_adapter
special_imports.c: void %s(WGPUInstance instance, WGPURequestAdapterOptions const * options, uint64_t future)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_adapter_request_device
special_imports.c: void %s(WGPUAdapter adapter, WGPUDeviceDescriptor const * descriptor, uint64_t future, uint64_t lost_future)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_buffer_map_async
special_imports.c: void %s(WGPUBuffer buffer, uint64_t mode, uint32_t offset, uint32_t size, uint64_t future)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_device_pop_error_scope
special_imports.c: void %s(WGPUDevice device, uint64_t future)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_device_create_compute_pipeline_async
special_imports.c: void %s(WGPUDevice device, WGPUComputePipelineDescriptor const * descriptor, uint64_t future)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_device_create_render_pipeline_async
special_imports.c: void %s(WGPUDevice device, WGPURenderPipelineDescriptor const * descriptor, uint64_t future)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_queue_on_submitted_work_done
special_imports.c: void %s(WGPUQueue queue, uint64_t future)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_shader_module_get_compilation_info
special_imports.c: void %s(WGPUShaderModule shader_module, uint64_t future)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_poll
special_imports.c: int32_t %s(void * buf, uint32_t cap)
special_imports.doc: Drives the backend once and writes ready event records. Returns bytes written, or -needed if the next record does not fit.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_epoch
special_imports.c: uint64_t %s(void)
special_imports.doc: Counts the event records queued so far. Read it before looking for ready events, then hand it to wasmer_wgpu_wait: an event that arrives in between (and may be collected by another guest thread) makes the wait return instead of being missed.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_wait
special_imports.c: int32_t %s(uint64_t const * futures, uint32_t count, uint64_t timeout_ns, uint64_t epoch, void * buf, uint32_t cap)
special_imports.doc: Blocks until one of the listed futures is ready, any event was queued since `epoch`, or the timeout elapses; then behaves like poll. INT32_MIN means this host cannot block.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_yield
special_imports.c: void %s(void)
special_imports.doc: Lets the host make progress on outstanding work. A no-op natively; one event-loop turn in a browser.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_instance_release
special_imports.c: uint32_t %s(WGPUInstance instance)
special_imports.doc: Releases one reference. Returns 1 when that was the last one held by the guest.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_buffer_release
special_imports.c: uint32_t %s(WGPUBuffer buffer)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_device_release
special_imports.c: uint32_t %s(WGPUDevice device)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_buffer_map_info
special_imports.c: uint32_t %s(WGPUBuffer buffer, void * out)
special_imports.doc: Writes { u64 offset; u64 size; u32 mode; u32 state } for the current mapping. Returns 0 for an unknown buffer.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_adapter_get_info
special_imports.c: int32_t %s(WGPUAdapter adapter, void * buf, uint32_t cap)
special_imports.doc: Serializes adapter info. Returns the bytes required; the buffer is filled only if that fits in cap.

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_device_get_adapter_info
special_imports.c: int32_t %s(WGPUDevice device, void * buf, uint32_t cap)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_device_get_features
special_imports.c: int32_t %s(WGPUDevice device, void * buf, uint32_t cap)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_instance_get_wgsl_language_features
special_imports.c: int32_t %s(WGPUInstance instance, void * buf, uint32_t cap)

special_imports.name: wasmer_wgpu_surface_get_capabilities
special_imports.c: int32_t %s(WGPUSurface surface, WGPUAdapter adapter, void * buf, uint32_t cap)
special_imports.doc: Serializes { u64 usages; u32 formats; u32 presentModes; u32 alphaModes; u32 pad } followed by the three u32 arrays. Negative on error.

_suspending_comment: Imports a browser host has to suspend the guest for (JSPI). Presenting waits for the next animation frame; creating a surface may have to fetch the canvas from another thread. Natively these simply block.

source_aliases.doc: Source compatibility with programs written for Emscripten, which has the same struct under this name. Hosts accept either sType.

structs.name: wasix_surface_source_canvas
structs.doc: Chained in WGPUSurfaceDescriptor to make a WGPUSurface from a presentation target the host provides (a canvas in the browser, a window or headless target natively).

members.name: selector
members.doc: Names the host-provided target, for example "#canvas". Empty selects the default target.

functions.name: wasix_get_size
functions.doc: Current size, in physical pixels, of the target behind the surface. Use it to (re)configure after wgpuSurfaceGetCurrentTexture reports Outdated.
